sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Jewel Explode is a match 3 game where you swap adjacent gems to create sets of three or more in a row. The game features a grid of gems, and the objective is to clear as many gems as possible within the given moves. With each level, the difficulty increases, and new obstacles are introduced, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.

The game has a variety of power-ups and special gems that can be used to aid you in clearing the board. These power-ups can be collected by creating specific sets of gems or by using special items. By mastering the use of these power-ups, you can overcome challenging levels and progress through the game.

As you progress, you'll encounter different types of obstacles, such as locked gems, which require specific combinations to unlock, and special gems that can be used to clear multiple gems at once. These obstacles add an extra layer of challenge and strategy to the game, making it more engaging and fun to play.
